products.name: Diamond & Pearl Value Pack 2 [Buizel]
products.note: Four Diamond & Pearl-series packs and an Energy coin in the real pack (Diamond & Pearl, Mysterious Treasures and Secret Wonders; the mix is not recorded, so all four open as Secret Wonders), with a cosmos holofoil Buizel promo and a cosmos holofoil Gible reprint (not simulated). Bulbapedia excerpt and Collector's Cache listing titles.

products.name: Diamond & Pearl Value Pack 1 [Pikachu]
products.note: Four Diamond & Pearl-series packs and a cosmos holofoil Pikachu promo in the red Value Pack 1 (Bulbapedia excerpt, September 2007); Collector's Cache files the same promo under a Secret Wonders Deck Pack. The pack mix is not recorded, so all four open as Secret Wonders. The two sources name different products: low-medium confidence.

products.name: Diamond & Pearl Trainer's Challenge Set [Shinx]
products.note: A learn-to-play set with two Diamond & Pearl-series packs and a cosmos holofoil Shinx promo (the inverse-back print is not a separate card). Collector's Cache and Bulbapedia name the Value Pack and the Trainer's Challenge Set as its homes; the pack count is from the Trainer's Challenge listing only: medium-low confidence.
